title: Church Holiness
definition: Church Holiness is the calling of Christ's people to be set apart from sin and devoted to God in doctrine, worship, conduct, and witness.
summary: Church Holiness is the congregation's corporate calling to be set apart for God in doctrine, worship, conduct, and witness.
christFocus: Jesus Christ cleanses His Church and presents her holy before Himself.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church holiness means the church is called to belong to God and reflect His character. Scripture describes believers as a holy people, set apart from sin and devoted to the Lord.

This holiness is not spiritual elitism or image management. It is the visible fruit of grace as Christ cleanses His people and teaches them to walk in truth.

Jesus gave Himself to make the church holy. The church's holiness rests in His saving work and grows through His ongoing sanctifying care.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Churches can protect reputation while neglecting true purity, or excuse sin in the name of acceptance. Church holiness keeps grace from becoming compromise and holiness from becoming pride.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pursue holiness together with humility. Confess sin, receive correction, protect the vulnerable, practice purity, and remember that the church is set apart for Christ, not for appearances.
